finding: Two P1 result booleans are source assertions rather than independently measured runtime facts: proof.explicit_read_transaction is assigned literal true and proof.writer_free_interval is assigned literal true. The first is strongly supported by the reviewed ro_snapshot implementation because it executes BEGIN on a read-only SQLite connection. The second is supported only by reviewed control-flow/isolation assumptions in this harness, not by a dynamic database-level observation that no other connection committed during the barrier interval.

evidence.source_basis_for_explicit_read_transacti: ro_snapshot opens mode=ro SQLite, executes BEGIN, then reads epoch/generation/tasks/scopes/leases inside that transaction
evidence.source_basis_for_writer_free_interval: parent seeds before spawning; ordinary child DB handles are mode=ro; parent performs no intentional S1 writes during the release-barrier interval
evidence.measurement_gap: No live observer connection, PRAGMA data_version/change counter, journal/WAL evidence, or equivalent runtime mechanism is sampled across the barrier to independently demonstrate zero committed writers.

hypothesis: Because the v2 acceptance runs against a fresh isolated temporary S1 database, exact source hashes plus ordinary-child mode=ro plus parent control flow may be sufficient to treat writer-free interval as a bounded source+runtime construction property even without an independent database-level counter.
counterhypothesis: A boolean named as a runtime proof must itself be dynamically established; otherwise an accidental future writer, helper, trigger, or refactor can leave writer_free_interval=true while violating the property. Source review alone is too brittle for successor-dynamic acceptance.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.preferred_future_repair: Keep a parent observer SQLite connection open before child spawn; sample PRAGMA data_version or an equivalent commit-sensitive database signal immediately before the concurrent window and immediately before release, and fail if it changes. Bind the observed values into the proof object. Also derive explicit_read_transaction from an instrumented child receipt or rename it as a source assertion.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.why: This converts the self-seeded boolean into a fail-closed runtime observation without introducing a second state authority or model-dependent logic.

hard_negatives: a proof JSON contains writer_free_interval=true, therefore no writer existed
a test boolean is true because the implementation hardcodes it, therefore the measured property passed
shared snapshot digests alone prove no transient or external commit happened during the whole overlap interval
source review is promoted to whole-HCU runtime evidence
positive_behavior: classify source assertions separately from dynamic observations
require successor-dynamic runtime instrumentation when the claim depends on a mutable execution fact
keep component credit bounded even when exact source identity is known

execution_decision.credit_review_note: If the exact pinned v2 runtime returns PASS, preserve the receipt. During credit review, treat the two self-asserted fields according to this audit rather than silently upgrading them to independent measurements. A successor can harden them without erasing the historical v2 run.

epistemic_boundary: Source audit only. No VPS execution, unusual experiment, training, provider call, canonical state mutation, or effect occurred in this artifact.
